description: The PB-18 RTO serves the Batala sub-division within the Gurdaspur district of Punjab. It is an active registration authority managed under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), facilitating vehicle registration, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the industrial hub of Batala.
address: S.D.M. Office, Batala, District Gurdaspur, Punjab - 143505
